description: This file defines the interface for JsonFieldDefinition, which specifies the schema or structure for JSON fields within the Eclipse Ditto project. It provides static factory methods to create field definitions for various JSON data types, methods to access properties such as pointers, types, and markers, and functions to map JSON values to Java types. The interface facilitates schema definitions, validation, and type mappings for JSON data in the project.

classes.name: JsonFieldDefinition
classes.description: Interface for defining schema/metadata of JSON fields, including factory methods for various types, property accessors, and value mapping.

methods.name: ofString
methods.description: Creates a new JSON field definition for a String value with optional markers.

methods.name: ofInt
methods.description: Creates a new JSON field definition for an int value with optional markers.

methods.name: ofLong
methods.description: Creates a new JSON field definition for a long value with optional markers.

methods.name: ofDouble
methods.description: Creates a new JSON field definition for a double value with optional markers.

methods.name: ofBoolean
methods.description: Creates a new JSON field definition for a boolean value with optional markers.

methods.name: ofJsonObject
methods.description: Creates a new JSON field definition for JsonObject type with optional markers.

methods.name: ofJsonArray
methods.description: Creates a new JSON field definition for JsonArray type with optional markers.

methods.name: ofJsonValue
methods.description: Creates a new JSON field definition for JsonValue type with optional markers.

methods.name: getPointer
methods.description: Returns the JSON pointer referring to this field definition.

methods.name: getValueType
methods.description: Returns the Java Class object representing the type of the value this field defines.

methods.name: getMarkers
methods.description: Returns the set of markers associated with this field, indicating semantics like schema version.

methods.name: isMarkedAs
methods.description: Checks if this field is marked with at least the specified markers.

methods.name: mapValue
methods.description: Converts a JsonValue to the Java type defined by this schema, throwing JsonParseException if incompatible.
